shellCommands.command: cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "---"; ls; echo "---"; find . -maxdepth 3 -iname "*.tsx" -o -iname "actions*" 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -30
find ./app -type f | grep -v node_modules; echo "---"; cat ./app/page.tsx; echo "---layout---"; cat ./app/layout.tsx 2>/dev/null

ls -la app/; echo "---"; cat tsconfig.json; echo "---"; find . -maxdepth 2 -iname "next.config*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*"; echo "---eval---"; cat __agent_eval__/* 2>/dev/null | head -100; ls __agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null
(npx next dev -p 3210 > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s http://localhost:3210/ | grep -o 'Notifications are currently [A-Z]*'

cd /workspace
ACTION_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3210/ | grep -o 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*"' | grep -o '[a-f0-9]\{40\}')
echo "action id: $ACTION_ID"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3210/ \
  -H "Next-Action: $ACTION_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" \
  --data '[]' -D - -o /tmp/resp.txt
echo "---body---"
cat /tmp/resp.txt | head -20
echo "---refetch---"
curl -s http://localhost:3210/ | grep -o 'Notifications are currently.\{0,20\}'

ACTION_ID="0018692959ce22af67d2a9321a57ddc1c833f5af74"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3210/ \
  -H "Next-Action: $ACTION_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" \
  --data '[]' -D - -o /tmp/resp.txt
echo "---headers/body head---"
head -30 /tmp/resp.txt
echo "---refetch page---"
curl -s http://localhost:3210/ | grep -o 'Notifications are currently.\{0,30\}' | head -1
